verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly specifies the SPS30 connector pinout with SEL connected to GND, establishing the hardware configuration.
The client tightens the hardware rule to require SEL hardwired to GND so the SPS30 remains in I2C mode; updating the existing connection key leaves no stale attribute.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports that the design PDF shows the SPS30 SEL pin connected to ground.
The message concerns general connector placement on the integrated board and does not modify the SPS30 SEL grounding or I2C-mode requirement.
